title: Hourly City and or Wine Tours of Seattle Wa
includes: Mobility Scooter can be added on at an additional $50 cost (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age requirement for alcohol consumption is 21 years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A ride that's designed to your liking. This listing is for 4hrs but times to each event can be doubled or adjusted if you choose to do more hours. This ride allows you to view beautiful WA with family and friends by your itinerary or our top favs! You dont have to worry about parking and wasting precious time and also you dont have to drive intoxicated on our WA streets if visiting the winery area. Luxury and comfort to sites all over town. Every stop can be as short or long as you'd desire. We will show you what you want to see and you decide pickup n drop off times as well. Many Vehicle to choose from to explore the adventure ahead. See you soon!
